title: The Slave Mentality Yesterday & Today: the True Diaspora

sense.text: Here is the mind of the negro slave, yesterday and today. It opens with our increase: “And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.” The land was filled with us.
“Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.” A new kingdom, a new dynasty, which forgot Joseph.
“Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we.” We always grow mightier. We were a strong people even then, and we are even till now.

The counsel was, “let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply.” The fear of the Egyptians was our multiplication, us overpopulating the land and outnumbering them. That was the fear: “when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.”

“Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.” We built for Pharaoh. The Valley of the Kings is one of the biggest tourist attractions in Egypt, and the pyramid of Giza. We built that. We did not build all the pyramids — there are many pyramids in Egypt — but the most notable one, the Valley of the Kings, was built by our slave labour.

Look at how those pharaohs are sitting on their thrones, and then go find the figure in the Washington monument in that same area, in the US capital: sitting the exact same way. That is not a coincidence, because America is spiritual Egypt. That is why the dollar bill has the all-seeing eye and the pyramid on the back of it, and why there is an obelisk sitting in the middle of freaking DC, and in Rome, and in Central Park. None of these apologists have an excuse for it; they have no biblical explanation for why that is. We know why. And by the way, we built the US capital. We built the White House.

“But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.” You know how black men are: we go through a hard time at work, come home to a wife, and babies are made. The more they afflicted us, the more we multiplied.

No matter how much hard work and labour they put on us, we just grew more and more. Even in slavery in the fields we grew more. They had breeding plantations too, where they forced us to make more babies for laborious work, especially in Virginia.
“And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour.” To serve with hard labour. Rigour.

“And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.” Keep that in mind: with morter and with brick, and all manner of service in the field. Hard labour.

So they had us working with brick and they had us working in the field. What is that called? Plantations. Egypt had plantations. And what material is Egypt best known for? Cotton. Egyptian cotton is known to be the best cotton there is.

“And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah.” Then the edict: “When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him.”

That means the Egyptians had a knowledge and a method, back then in ancient times, of how to perform abortions. They taught their midwives and gave them that specialty and that knowledge, how to kill babies, how to abort babies. Abortion is not new. It is nothing new.

“But if it be a daughter, then she shall live.” If it is a girl she lives, because the nation is basically the man. We are the origin of the nation. Kill the males and the nation ceases to be. We are the seed and the woman is the soil; take away the seed and there is no more plant.
“But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.” They did it because they loved their people.

“Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.” They are different women, they are not the same. Lively means that by the time the midwives got there the women had delivered their own babies. Our women had the knowledge of how to deliver their own children: they got on the stool and pushed them out, and by the time anybody arrived the baby was already born. They could not be stopped from doing that.

In modern times they call that being born in the field. When your child is born outside of a hospital, in the house or wherever, they say that child was born in the field — a field baby, and it is meant as an insult. A childbirth that occurs unexpectedly outside of a hospital or an intended clinical setting, in an outdoor, rural or emergency environment. So our sisters back then, as our sisters do now, brought forth children outside of a hospital. That is what being lively is.

“Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty. And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.” He built them houses for looking out for their people. They loved those sisters, they loved their brothers, they loved their people.

“And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.” So the new law was: if you cannot kill them in the womb, kill them outside the womb. When the males are born, throw them in the river.

Later on that became gator bait. All of this is us — working in the fields, hard labour, the sons targeted to be killed, thrown in the river, gator bait. There are no white gator bait babies. There are no Arab gator bait babies, no Asian gator bait babies. Where are they? They are non-existent. This is judgment.

History is repetition. It loops over and over and over again, and it is nothing new. Our sons are still being targeted: the autism the CDC reports was targeting the males, and it only became a problem once it started affecting white males — it was not a problem before. The drugs targeted the males. The crack cocaine era targeted the males. Abortion targets the males. Homosexuality targets the males. Emasculation targets the males. Nothing new under the sun.

“Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.” This is after Moses fled Egypt, having killed the Egyptian. Here is Mount Sinai.

“And the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.” The bush was on fire but it was not burning up. So Moses said, “I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.” What is this?

“Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.” Hold on, before you get too close: take your shoes off. This is the same place Moses got the laws of God, Mount Sinai, or Horeb. The same place.

“I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows.” I heard their cry and I know their sorrows. I know my people. I see their suffering.

“And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.” He is going to give them land — “the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.”

“I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.” He saw the oppression: the all manner of work in the fields, the all manner of working in brick, them throwing our babies into the mouth of a gator, them aborting our children.

Because there were midwives who were successful at it. It was not just those two sisters. Those two sisters said no; others of them said yes and were killing our males. But it was not enough. Not enough.
“Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.” Unto Pharaoh — the president.

“Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.” You are going to come right back to this mountain, the very place where I am talking to you right now, and there he received God's laws.

“Thus the Lord saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.” Israel witnessed their oppressor being destroyed. The Red Sea smashed upon Egypt's army and they watched them all die.

“And Israel saw that great work which the Lord did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the Lord, and believed the Lord, and his servant Moses.” They got delivered. They got their deliverance through Moses, and they were happy, rejoicing.

precepts.why:
They were so happy they broke out in song: “Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the Lord, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.”

Read on and the song keeps going: “The Lord is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him. The Lord is a man of war: the Lord is his name. Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.”

Their enemies, their oppressors, are killed, and Israel is singing songs over it. Hold that right there, because of what comes next, shortly after the departure out of Egypt.

sense.text: “And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.” Remember, we had just got delivered.

“And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness.” Now we are complaining. We were working hard labour, getting our behinds beat by the taskmasters, and here we are shortly after the departure from Egypt, at the Exodus, complaining about being in the wilderness.

“Would to God we had died by the hand of the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full.” We should have died in Egypt. Why are we out here dying, out here in the wilderness? We ate good, we drank good, we lived good — and we were slaves. That is slave talk.

“For ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.” You brought us out here to die, Moses. Mind you, earlier they were singing and dancing, free, their enemies all dead. Now it is, you brought us out here to die. These are slaves. These are broken men, and women.

Harriet Tubman said she would have saved thousands more slaves had they known they were still slaves. It is the same mentality here. Slave mentality. What they called Harriet Tubman was a nickname: Moses. That is why she walked around with a shotgun. You want to go back home? Okay, let's go back home. Let's go. Click, click. You are going back home — and it is not the home you are thinking about.

precepts.why:
This is what the complaining got: “And when the people complained, it displeased the Lord: and the Lord heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the Lord burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.” Israel is complaining, being rebellious, and now they are being put to death. Fire came down from the Lord and started burning them alive.

“And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the Lord, the fire was quenched. And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the Lord burnt among them.”

“And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting.” These are heathens that fled out of Egypt along with us, and they start to complain and lust to go back to the land too. “And the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?” So now you have heathen influence convincing us to complain more about being free. The heathens say, we’re in the world with these damn Israelites; we starving too — and Israel takes it up.

“We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick.” We sure did eat good in Egypt. Now we are stuck in the wilderness and we are getting none of that. They were free, but their minds were not.

Likewise black people and Hispanics today. Our minds are not free at all. We have freedoms, but we ain't free — we have privileges, not freedoms here. It is in how a negro talks: our country, we going to space, our war, our military. We going to space? They got black rocket ships? And then: these black immigrants, them damn Haitians and Jamaicans taking all the jobs. You know what is taking jobs? AI is taking jobs, and nobody says anything about that, they are quiet, because Massa made AI, and I love AI. So I will blame the Mexicans instead. What jobs are they taking? Selling in the street? Working on somebody's roof for thousands of dollars less than we get paid? Working in the fields, picking fruit and vegetables for cents on a dime? You are not doing that.

Meanwhile the biggest alien on the planet, the biggest illegal alien on the earth, is the white man. He stole America. He stole Australia. He stole Israel. He stole Africa too. We have no words for him. None. But them black immigrants, they are the problem. Trump plans to bring the Dutch South Africans over here and pay them five thousand dollars a head in aid — from whose tax dollars? Yours. And what do the black Americans say about that? Nothing. The white man snuck thousands of Afghanis into Chicago. What did black folks say? Nothing.

It is selective anger. I don't want to be mad at the white man, so I am going to be mad at my own people, because they cannot defend themselves. I will attack the Caribbeans and the continental Israelites because they are defenseless. But the white man who immigrated here, or the Afghani, or the Ukrainians — I am not talking about them. Even though the East Indians are coming here taking all the tech jobs, because they are cheaper labour. That is the slave mentality.

Here we go again: “And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night. And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron.”

“And the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!” We should have died in Egypt. “And wherefore hath the Lord brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?” We need to go back to Massa. Go back home.

Then watch what they say to one another: “Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.” Return to slavery. That is the black man today, the black woman today: let us return to slavery. We are free here, I am a citizen, let's vote, politics works. It is the same thing — let's appoint a captain and go back to Egypt. It is a slave mentality. Let's vote for Trump, we need Trump.

That is the same man who told you there are no reparations: ask for reparations and you hate America, I am not giving you anything. And what do we say? Surely he ain't talking about us. Not Massa. Massa love us. We going to get money, we always been here, we foundational, we been here since the beginning, we is Indians. Which Indian are you? He is talking to the Ghanaians, he is talking to the Nigerians — did America colonize Ghana? No. Did America colonize Nigeria? No. That was the British. He is talking to you. That is the slave mind.

sense.text:
Here is the recap, because it goes over the heads of the Christian lovers. First you are blinded from seeing that you are oppressed. When you do not understand that this system is oppression, from Exodus up to this day — this system is oppression — and you take that out of the picture, now you are a new person with a new heart in Jesus Christ.

But “oppression maketh a wise man mad.” Deuteronomy 28 has all the wisdom in it for you to understand why you are suffering right now. Erase that, and you no longer have a revolutionary mind. Without the revolutionary mind you hate your own people, and you would die with Esau.

The revolutionary mind is what goes into a Marcus Garvey, and there are brothers who speak against Marcus Garvey. He was not what they call him. Before the civil rights movement he was one of the greatest revolutionaries — Christ obviously is number one — and he had the largest black organization known to man.

What that brother did was sit down with a Klan grand dragon to discuss how we could separate from them, because he was about leaving Esau alone: listen, you hate me, I hate you, let's separate from each other, have our own town over here and you over there. We would come out fine without them; we did fine without them. So they bombed us and flooded our towns, and they went after Garvey with mail fraud — a bunch of coons like W. E. B. Du Bois and all the other bougie ones that love white folks saying he was having secret councils with the KKK. Yeah, he was: figuring out how to get away from their ass, how to separate.

These are the blessings for doing what God says: “And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth.”

He will set thee on high above all nations of the earth. That is called supremacy. God will give us supremacy over the earth — not black supremacy, just Israelite supremacy. Theocracy, God's government. That is what that is.

And that is if we kept God's laws. What did we do? The opposite.

The other side of it: “But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee.” All these curses will come upon you and overtake you.

“Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.” Remember what we read earlier: even before the curses start, we were already cursed. We were in Egypt working in the field, and cursed in the city.

We were placed in Goshen. That was the outskirts. That was the hood. That is redlining. Egypt said, go over there, you shepherds live over there. That is segregation. Goshen was redlining, that is what it was. You can't stay here, you can't eat with us — Hebrews can't eat with Egyptians. That is Jim Crow. It is all in the Bible. We are all in it. You just have to read it. It is talking about us, no one else.

The argument against this verse is that all the curses occurred in the land. Did all the curses occur in our land only? No. The Lord said he would scatter us where? To the four corners. Is there four corners of the land? He said he would give us vexation and pestilence; when Israel fled to Egypt did we get vexation and pestilence there? Yes. Was that our land? No. He said he would make us a byword and a proverb among all the nations whither he would lead us. Is that the land too? Every curse in 28 is not in the land, dummy.

Then there is the word itself. The first official ghetto was established in Venice, Italy, in 1516, when the Venetian government forced all the local Jews to live on a small island that had formerly been the site of a copper foundry. The Venetian word for foundry was ghetto, and the name stuck. From the sixteenth to the nineteenth century, mandatory walled Jewish enclaves spread across Europe, to Rome, Florence, Prague and Frankfurt. From there the word passed into most other European languages, and since the late nineteenth century its meaning has been extended to crowded urban districts where other ethnic or racial groups have been confined by poverty or prejudice. Who is that? That is us.

So wherever Jews are forced to live is called the ghetto. Where black folks are forced to live is the ghetto. Why are we forced to live in ghettos? Because we are Jews. That is why. And the forced urban isolation is the same thing as redlining, walled restricted urban areas.

And their own say it. Nachmanides, an Israelite scholar and elder of the dark ages, held that the centuries of persecution, including the confinement to ghettos, are the historical fulfilment of the Deuteronomy 28 curses. He said being put in ghettos fulfils 28:16, and he said it long before anybody called it black Hebrew Israelite theology — which is what we have been saying forever. For thousands of years both Jewish and Christian commentators have viewed these exact historical periods of confinement, exile and persecution as the literal, tragic realization of the warnings laid out in Deuteronomy 28. So they agree the prophecy refers to the Israelis, and when we say it is us, then it is only our ideology. Do you see the evil? We say it is the ghettos; they say no, it is the ghettos for the white people, not for you. You cannot make it up.

Their own books also say who the people under this curse look like. Maurice Fishberg's book on the Jews, from 1886, says the predominant type of complexion of the Jews of today is also dark, and that black and brown hair and eyes are in the majority; and that the fair-haired Jews create a problem for anthropologists, because it is a question from where these Indo-Germanic Jews found their way into the midst of a dark-complexioned race like the Jews. A dark-complexioned race — not a religion, not a faith, not rabbinical Judaism. A race. They were asking where these white people came from, because the race of the Jews is dark and always has been. They are black in Portugal, black in Spain, black in Africa; so who are these Europeans? That is like saying Brad Pitt and Wesley Snipes are twin brothers. Make no damn sense. Not the same people.

It says even the Spanish and Portuguese Jews — the ones who were expelled out of Spain, which led to the transatlantic slave trade. There would be no Atlantic slave trade if it were not for the expulsion of the Jews. The Sephardim, who have been considered to be of a much darker complexion than the Eastern European Jews, the Ashkenazim, also have a fair number of blondes among them — because they are Edom, they are Europeans, and they mixed around white folks. And it says the Sephardim have been reputed to have preserved the Jewish type more perfectly, because they retained the ancient features of the Israelites: dark complexion.

Roberta Strauss's book on the fate of the Jews says the Sephardic Jews of Spain, the dark-complexioned ones who maintained the Jewish type perfectly, who spoke and wrote first Arabic and then Ladino — they were the Jews that followed Islam, the Moors, and Ladino is Hebrew mixed with Spanish; Latino, that is where the word Latino comes from — shared neither language nor customs nor origin nor culture with the Ashkenazic Jews of Eastern Europe who spoke and wrote Yiddish. Or shittish? It ain't real Hebrew. They are not the same people. The locks, the big old hat, the dirty freaking yarmulke — that is not ours.

That same book says Judah P. Benjamin — he is the one that funded the KKK, he funded it, they are behind the KKK — who held three successive positions in the Confederate cabinet, part of the Confederacy that would maintain slavery, owned a large plantation near New Orleans with 140 slaves; that possibly a greater proportion of Jews than Christians were slave owners, and a disproportionately large number of Jewish merchants sold slaves, were involved in the slave trade and insured the ships. A child of God, an Israelite, had us as his slaves. And it says comparisons between Jews who were slaves in Egypt and blacks who were slaves in America upset Jews who identify with the slave owners, not the slaves. They did not want to talk about being slaves in Egypt; they preferred to be recognized as slave owners. And it says that where blacks were available, neither Jews nor any other whites were slaves — any other whites. They are white. When the line was drawn between the races, they were on the white side. They were Caucasians.

New World Jewry, written by their own people, says the Jews were more visible in New Holland since they formed a larger percentage of the European population than they did in Amsterdam, and that Protestant missionaries could not invade Jewish plantations to proselytize the negro slaves and the Indians. They were acknowledged as Europeans then. All of a sudden now they are not.

A treatise on physical geography from 1850, a white-eyes-only book, says the Jews are a people who, according to the prophecy, ever dwelt alone without intermixing with the nations to this day; that this separate race, all descended from brown ancestors — Abraham, Isaac and Jacob — must have been as dark as the Arabian if not darker; and that they exhibit every shade of colour, from the black Jews of Malabar onward. It says we need go no further than the Jews of southern Spain, which are dark, and compare them with those of Holland and northern Germany to perceive a very striking difference: the Spanish Jew is always dark complexioned and his hair is uniformly black, whilst the German Jew is often as fair as any German, with light or red hair and blue eyes. Caucasians. And it says the various shades of colour observable among the negro or African race tend to the same conclusion: along the coast of Guinea, which is low, marshy and hot, we find jet black complexions, and this is the very country from which American negroes have been derived. Those blacks in Guinea were the Israelites who fled there out of Spain and Portugal, and that is where most of the American negroes were taken from and brought over here. This was published in 1850. They knew who they were bringing over here.

Now we trying to save Massa from hell or go to hell with him. That is where we are now.

Breasted's Ancient Times has a page that was taken out of the second edition. The Rothschilds were so impressed with the man's research that they gave him millions of dollars to build his own university, and read the book to their children every night, on one condition: rewrite it and take some things out. We own the copy that still has the things in it. The picture is of an ancient Egyptian painting of a brickyard with Asiatic captives engaged in brickmaking — those Asiatic captives are Israelites, that is what we were called in Egypt as slaves — and the line printed under it reads, the Hebrew slave working in the Egyptian brickyard, and that it must have looked like this when Moses led them forth into Asia. What were we doing in Egypt? Making brick and working in the fields. Are those white folks in that picture? No, sir. Hell no. So if Moses passed for an Egyptian, Moses must have looked like that. Israelites were always black, different shades of brown.

So do not play with us up here. Stop saying we are fake. Go talk to Netanyahu over there, go talk to them Zionists, the Steinbergs, the Rosenbergs, the Oppenheimers, the Cohens, the Weinsteins. Go question them over there about who they are.

Then the two spheres of the verse. It divides life into two distinct worlds, the city, urban, and the field, country, rural, and says the curse would strike both: no matter what, no matter where they live, whether in the land or outside the land, or how they make a living, they cannot escape the consequence of breaking the covenant. In biblical times cities were the centres of commerce, governance and social structure, so curses in the city meant a breakdown of society itself. Economic collapse: trade routes would fail, markets would dry up and poverty would take over — we lose our businesses, Black Wall Street gone, destroyed. Social and civil unrest: lawlessness, crime among us now, black-on-black crime. Political corruption: the wicked leaders in Africa, for example, or the Caribbean. Internal strife will destroy the peace: violence, gang violence. Vulnerability: ancient cities relied on walls for protection, and a cursed city meant those walls would fail, leading to siege, disease and enemy invasion — conquered, overthrown, colonization. And the rural sphere, the country, that goes into famine.

So the question was put to it plainly: is this referring to the ghetto or the slums? The answer came back that whether Deuteronomy 28:16 applies to living in the ghettos depends on whether you look at the text through the lens of mainstream historical biblical scholarship or through the specific theological views of certain modern religious movements like the black Hebrew Israelites. Why is this here? Google is saying to me, don't listen to the BHIs, listen to the scholars. So if a brother goes in and types, hey, is being in the ghetto part of the curses, it is going to say this. Don't ignore the BHIs — that shows you the impact we are having on this world, that AI is being set up to fight against us too.

It goes on: certain modern religious groups, primarily the black Hebrew Israelites, teach that Deuteronomy 28 serves as a prophetic racial diagnostic tool to identify the true descendants of biblical Israel, and they point to verses like Deuteronomy 28:16, cursed shall you be in the city, and Deuteronomy 28:68, going into Egypt again with ships, and argue that these prophecies directly describe the transatlantic slave trade, the cotton fields of the American South, and the poverty and systemic oppression found in modern inner-city ghettos. That is a fact. The conclusion in that view is that modern marginalized groups such as African-Americans, Hispanics and Native Americans — and the diaspora — are experiencing the literal fulfilment of these curses because they are the true physical Israelites. Then the mainstream theologians, historians and biblical scholars view the text quite differently, arguing that applying Deuteronomy 28 directly to modern ghettos is a misinterpretation that removes the passage from its original setting. And guess who is buying up the AI? The Israelis are buying up the AI. That is why you have this. These are digital safeguards against us here.

Back to 16 again, and the ghetto itself. The experience of the Spanish and Portuguese Jews, the Sephardim, in the Italian ghettos is one of the most fascinating and complex chapters in Jewish history. They were placed in these ghettos, but their experience was vastly different from that of the German or Italian Jews who were already there. Those are the ones that caused the problem for the anthropologists earlier: these guys do not look like the other ones, because these are the converts that fled there first. They fled to Italy because they could blend in amongst the other Italians, and Italy was Christian, Catholic at the time, so they said, now you guys follow that Judaism, throw your ass in that ghetto over there, we don't want you over here with that Judaism stuff.

Because of their immense wealth, international trading networks and unique history as forced converts, they held a highly specialized, privileged yet strictly segregated status. That is us, and we were placed in these ghettos. We had Black Wall Street, Black Bottom Detroit, Lakeland, Rosewood. We always had money, so when we went somewhere we brought money with us. Those ones there were poor. And we stay to ourselves.

In Venice the government split the ghetto population into distinct nations based on where they came from. The Ashkenazi and the Italiani, the German and the Italian — the Romans that converted — lived in the ghetto nuovo, the new ghetto; they were generally poor and legally restricted mostly to money lending and selling secondhand clothes. They're bums. But the Ponentine, meaning westerners, was the official legal term Venice used for the Spanish and Portuguese Jews — the black ones — because Venice desperately needed the global trading connections of these Iberian merchants to compete with the Ottoman Empire, the Arabs. They needed our money, like they do today: our money, our business. The Venetian Senate passed a famous decree in 1589 explicitly inviting the Ponentines to settle in Venice, and the catch was that they had to live inside the ghetto. You can come here, but you have to stay in the ghetto. Remember during this time we were being kicked out of Spain and Portugal, we were being killed out of Spain, so we ran there for comfort. Exile.

The influx of Spanish and Portuguese Jews was so large and so economically impactful that the original ghetto could not hold them — you know how we do, we multiply, like in Egypt. So Venice expanded the enclosed zone by adding the ghetto vecchio, the old ghetto, and later the ghetto novissimo, the newest ghetto, specifically to house the Sephardic and Levantine merchants. That is us. They had the new ghetto and they gave us the old ghetto. And even though they were wealthy they were subjected to the same physical restrictions: they were locked inside the gates at night — they had us in gated communities, put there against our will — forced to pay inflated rents, and required to wear identifying clothing like yellow caps. They were exploiting us. They were slumlords. They had us living in ghettos with inflated rents. That is today: you go to New York, the damn ghetto is like $2,000 for one bedroom, a studio is like $1,500 with a kitchenette, your bathroom and your kitchen the same place; you wash your ass to cook at the same time, it is the same damn place; and mind you, those rates are not in the upper communities, they are in the hood.

And the definition of ghetto, when you read down, the second one always speaks about the economically deprived. Look at our people as a whole: the economic system was not even made for us at all, and even when we try to get in with Esau we are still at the bottom. Influencers, for example, is a niche where black people are making money now, and if you read up on influencers they will not get the same amount of money that white folks get doing the exact same thing, because we are capped at a level. Having financial advantage would mean better education, sending your kids to school. So the disadvantage of us is to be docile, lack of education, lack of information, and then we are going to trust in white oppression, and then we are going to trust in voting, and then we become weak and feeble like the Christian church wants our black men to become. Like that dude that says, I'll go to hell if he is going to hell, I'll go there with him. I'll save you, master, I'll bring a cup of water with us, let's go to hell together.

Then the history of the German and the Italiani Jews. The Talmud does contain traditions about Romans converting to Judaism — that is the Italian Jews. When the Jews were being killed and persecuted by the Romans we were resilient, we were brave, we had no fear; we did not cry, it was, hurry this up, let's go. So the Romans looked at it and said, wow, that is God, you become like that, I want to be one. And that is what they were doing: they began to convert. They wanted the power. The Babylonian Talmud gives a very clear example of a Roman who converted to Judaism; the story behind the man is obscure, but he did exist.

There is historical evidence for Jewish migration from Italy into the Rhineland, into Germany, because these Romans that converted to Judaism migrated into Germany, and that contributed to the formation of the medieval Ashkenazi community. The Ashkenazic community, according to tradition, stems from Romans that converted to Judaism and later on Khazars that converted to Judaism. This is in their own record books; their own scholars say this. A bunch of Romans that converted to being a race of people that they were not, left Italy and moved into Germany and formed what we know of today as the Ashkenazi communities. These are Europeans. These are not Israelites ever.

The particularly concrete example is an important Jewish scholarly family that traced its origins to Italy, migrated from southern Italy into Germany and became the Ashkenazi. Starting with them: these are Romans, these are Germans, all the same race of people. They either migrated from Italy or they migrated from Ukraine, Russia, and they are all the same people. That is why anthropologists had a hard time figuring out where these guys come from, these Indo-Europeans, because the Jews are dark complexion all the time. Where do these guys come from? Italy, Germany, Russia, Poland, Ukraine. That is where they came from. These are converts, poor cave dwellers that ran into the ghetto, and we came there with money. You know how we do: we come there and make the ghetto nice, do what we can do — and eventually we got conquered and enslaved by those same people, and they became us.

precepts.why:
The word we get called comes out of this curse. “The Lord shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.” Removed — not removed in the land. Removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.

Track the word diaspora: 1825 in reference to Moravian Protestants, 1869 in reference to the dispersion of the Jews, from the Greek diaspora, dispersion, from a verb meaning to scatter about, disperse — dia, about or across, plus a word meaning to scatter, as in sparse. And the Greek word was used in the Septuagint at Deuteronomy 28:25. So the word diaspora was coined from the Greek of this very curse: the word removed here is dispersed in the Greek, and from that came dispersion, diaspora.

That means the word diaspora has no meaning without Israelites. It applies to Israelites. It was coined from the curses of the Israelites. Ghetto was formed because of Israelites. Cursed in the city, us. Cursed in the field, us. Black folks are the diaspora — the Atlantic slave trade, and the unspoken-of transpacific and East African slave trade perpetrated by the Arabs, and by the Portuguese and the Spaniards and the Portuguese Jewish merchants. Every part of this Bible belongs to us. Every ounce of it.

“And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other.” One end of the earth, not the land. Read it again: scattered among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other. Is that curse in our land? No, dummies.

Read on: “and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.” Scattered among all people, and there serving other gods we never knew. And how we got there is by ships, in verse 68.

Their own scholars point to this same verse — the Lord will scatter you among all peoples from one end of the earth to the other — to explain why the Jewish people spent millennia exiled from their homeland, living under foreign rulers who restricted them to specific city quarters. So this verse reaches outside the land when it is about them, and only inside the land when it is about us.

sense.text:
“The Lord shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart.” As a curse, God will smite us with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.

An astonishment of heart means a state of deep mental confusion, bewilderment, lostness and inner panic, sent as a consequence of turning away from God. The word translated as astonishment or bewilderment implies a throwing of the mind out of its normal state, leading to a paralyzing mental fall: you do not know where you are going, who you are, who your God is, or where you belong. While the other curses in the chapter affect physical health, crops or military strength, this curse strikes the inner person — the mind, the will and the emotions.

The trio. Madness is a frantic loss of sanity or emotional stability when facing overwhelming calamities, afflictions, adversities. Blindness is a spiritual or mental inability to see truth, understand reality, or perceive a way out. That is our people. That is the brother in that video saying, if he goes to hell, then so am I — that is madness. Understand that they are Israelites? No, we are all children of God; the Bible is for white people; that is not the ghetto, that is not us; and the slave ships, those are not real. Blindness is also the ghettos, the slums, the gang violence, no way out, caught in the trap. Astonishment of heart is a stunned, stupefied condition where a person loses the capacity to think clearly, make sound decisions, or feel steady under pressure. That is our people as a whole.

That trio destroyed us. That curse by itself is devastating to our people. We have lost it. And that is the strong delusion the Lord said he would send to our people.

That is why all these books have to come out. These books are worthless to me; the Bible is the most important. But because we are so destroyed and slave-minded, I have to go get the white man's book and say, look, see, we are black Jews — oh, now I understand. That is blindness.

The Mis-Education of the Negro puts the same thing plainly. It says no systematic effort toward change has been possible, for the Negro has been taught the same economics, history, philosophy, literature and religion which have established the present code of morals, and the Negro's mind has been brought under the control of his oppressor. The problem of holding the negro down is therefore easily solved: when you control a man's thinking, you do not have to worry about his actions, you do not have to tell him not to stand here or go yonder, he will find his proper place and will stay in it. That place is the ghetto. You do not need to send him to the back door, he will go without being told; in fact, if there is no back door, he will cut one for his special benefit, because his education makes it necessary.

It says the same educational process which inspires and stimulates the oppressor with the thought that he is everything and has accomplished everything worthwhile, depresses and crushes at the same time the spark of genius in the negro, by making him feel that his race does not amount to much and never will measure up to the standards of other people. That is why we cannot say we are God's people — we refuse to believe it, because the white man took control of our minds. The negro thus educated in white supremacy is a hopeless liability of the race. Keep that word, hopeless. And the difficulty is that the educated negro is compelled to live and move among his own people, whom he has been taught to despise, so he prefers to buy his food from a white grocer, because the white man's ice is colder than a black man's ice; because he has been taught the negro is not clean, and it does not matter how often a negro washes his hands he cannot clean them, and it does not matter how often a white man uses his hands he cannot soil them, because he is God.

It says that starting out after the Civil War it was well understood that if, by the teaching of history, the white man could be further assured of his superiority, and the negro could be made to feel that he had always been a failure and that the subjection of his will to some other race is necessary, then the free man would still be a slave. If you can control a man's thinking you do not have to worry about his actions; when you determine what a man shall think, you do not have to concern yourself about what he will do. If you make a man feel that he is inferior, you do not have to compel him to accept an inferior status, for he will seek it himself. If you make a man think that he is justly an outcast, you do not have to order him to the back door, he will go without being told, and if there is no back door his very nature will demand one.

And it says a mind that remains in the present atmosphere never undergoes sufficient development to experience what is commonly known as thinking; that no negro submerged in the ghetto will ever have a clear conception of the present status of the race, or sufficient foresight to plan for the future; and that he drifts so far toward compromise that he loses moral courage. That is the brother who said he was a revolutionary and then gave his heart to Christ. No courage at all. The education of the negro then becomes a perfect device for control from without, and those who purposely promote it have every reason to rejoice, while negroes themselves exaltedly champion the cause of the oppressor.

They champion the cause of the oppressor. They speak ill against their own brothers that are immigrants, quote unquote. They speak ill of their own people. Voting. They support Trump, they support voting, they side with white supremacist groups or branch out from them. Imagine being a pioneer of a movement that speaks evil of Caribbeans while your sister marries a Caribbean, and you go to the wedding on top of that and put it on social media. Why are you there? These damn Hispanics. Congratulations, sis. You're married to a Hispanic. That don't make sense. That's your leader.

The back door is in us too. When we come into the truth and get the law, statutes and commandments, we so much do not believe we are the chosen people of God that instead of following the commandments we go in the back door. Marriage in Israel is good for you, the greatest people, the marriage is beautiful, but negroes will find a way to do that thing back door. That is that spirit.

And it is why we ask instead of demand. Black folks say, excuse me sir, Massa, can I get reparations, and the white man says no, he is talking to the Ghanaians — he is talking to us. That is a slave mentality. Is reparations a request or a demand? What should it be? A demand is met with consequences: if you do not give me X, Y and Z, we will be forced to do A, B, C. But you are asking Massa for money, so go sit back down in the corner. That is not a demand. You have to have leverage. What are you going to do if he does not give you the money? How about this: do not celebrate Christmas any more. No New Year's, no Thanksgiving, no Valentine's Day. Do not go to their sports games, do not watch their movies, make your own movies. Cut all the holidays, and watch the country fall apart from that alone.

But black folks will say it is not salvific — a big swelling word that means it is not salvation-based, so I can do whatever Massa says because it does not matter, I can still be saved. No. Nowhere does God say celebrate Halloween. Nowhere does God say celebrate the dead. Halloween is Samhain, it is a pagan custom. So you are going to celebrate sorcery in Christ. He will make a back door away from God's commandments. Surely he will make one. He will demand one.

“Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?” Israel a servant, a homeborn slave. What does a homeborn slave translate to? A slave born in a house.

Why is he spoiled? Why is he destroyed? Here is why.

precepts.why:
“Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?” He planted us a noble vine, wholly a right seed, and we turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine.

That is why he is spoiled: we became a degenerate plant. Twerking, gang banging, crime, mumbling rap music, degeneracy, violence, not knowing who we are, hating each other, attacking each other. Wearing a white woman's hair, a white man's hair, an East Indian woman's hair — degeneracy. The long eyelashes, degeneracy. Tight ass pants hanging off your ass. Degeneracy. Vaping, alcoholism, drug addiction, degeneracy. Bleaching your skin; in the Caribbean they walk around in the heat with hoodies on so the sun will not touch them and they can stay light, and they end up with white fingers and black knuckles from all that bleaching. Destroyed. Degenerate.

And no washing takes it off: “For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap”.

Here is the why underneath it. “Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst” — withhold yourself from sin. “But thou saidst, There is no hope.” That is what we say: there is no hope, there is no God, there is no hope.

“No; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.” We love other nations, and after them we will go — even to hell, I will go with them. I love Massa; where Massa goes, that is where I am going to be.

That is why we became degenerate.

sense.text:
“The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master’s crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.” The ox knows his owner and the donkey knows his master's crib, but Israel does not know. We do not know who we are, where we come from, who our God is — none of that.

And Christianity makes that normal. Christianity solidifies the ignorance of the ox not knowing his owner, or his own crib, his own home. Christianity makes you not care: as long as you are in Christ it does not matter. It is brainwashing.

precepts.why:
“My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge.” We are destroyed for lack of knowledge. “Because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee.” We rejected knowledge, and he rejected us as a result.

“That thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.” No priest to him. And what we forgot is the law of our God.

That is the ox not knowing his owner. We forgot the laws of God and became degenerate plants. That is what happened: unto strangers I will go.

sense.text:
“Hope deferred maketh the heart sick.” Deferred means it is put on pause, it is stopped, it is ended.

Remember what we just read, that we said there is no hope, and that we refuse to do what God says. So hope deferred makes the mind sick — sick with what? With madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart. That is the sick right there: unable to see the truth, unable to see reality.

“But when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.” When the desire to keep God's commandments comes, it is a tree of life.

precepts.why:
“O thou mighty God above all, hear the voice of the forlorn and deliver us out of the hands of the mischievous, and deliver me out of my fear.” Hear the voice of the forlorn, and deliver us out of the hands of the mischievous — out of the nations.

Forlorn is not a common word. It is an adjective describing someone or something appearing lonely, unhappy and miserable, typically due to abandonment or a lack of care. Sad and lonely. Feeling or looking deeply abandoned and wretched — and we are a people who are wretched; that goes back to the word ratchet. Empty or neglected, describing a place that is run down: that is the ghettos, the slums. Empty and dreary. Hopeless. Unlikely to succeed or to achieve a positive outcome — and that is the blindness from earlier.

It comes from a mid-twelfth-century Middle English word meaning lost completely; it is the past participle of an Old English verb meaning to lose, abandon or destroy, with the prefix for- meaning completely. Lose completely. Lost. So forlorn means the lost.

And what did Christ say? I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel. Not the lost sheep of the house of everybody.

“For thy power standeth not in multitude nor thy might in strong men: for thou art a God of the afflicted, an helper of the oppressed, an upholder of the weak, a protector of the forlorn, a saviour of them that are without hope.”

God is the God of the afflicted. He is the helper of the oppressed — and are we oppressed people here in America? Yes, and everywhere else. So he is a God of us. Is God the upholder of the weak? Yes.

And he is a protector of the forlorn: the protector of the lost, the hopeless, the abandoned, the outcast. That is us. We are the forlorn. And a saviour of them that are without hope — a saviour of them that are hopeless. That is us.

sense.text:
“Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.”

We please ourselves in the children of strangers. We follow other nations' ideologies, doctrines and philosophies, and especially what you call not salvific: their holidays, holidays that are non-biblical. You will argue about Christ being three persons in one, a three-in-one god, a Harvey Dent deity, but you will not argue against the evils or the origins of Halloween or Christmas or New Year's. That is out for discussion, but Christ being three in one, that is important. I will be in idolatry, and while I am in idolatry I know Christ is three in one.

We are forlorn. We are completely lost and destroyed.

“And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not.” He will cause us to discontinue our heritage.

What does heritage mean? Heritage is the valuable history, traditions, beliefs and physical objects passed down from past generations. Tangible heritage is the physical things you can touch, such as historic buildings, monuments, art and landscapes. Intangible heritage is the non-physical practices: languages, oral stories, music, social customs and recipes. Language is heritage. The Bible is heritage.

That heritage was discontinued. When you discontinue from your language, your oral stories, your social customs, you lose your identity. Heritage is one word: identity. Language, oral stories, social customs, music, landscapes, historical buildings, monuments, art — that is heritage. So God said you will discontinue. It means you are going to lose it. You will forget. You will be lost. Forlorn.

precepts.why:
“Beside this he gave them knowledge, and the law of life for an heritage.” He gave us the laws of God for an inheritance. So the heritage is the law.

Once our laws were removed from us, we were indoctrinated with Christianity. When you strip us of our laws you strip us of our identity. Our laws are part of our race. Our law is part of our identity. Strip us of that and we have nothing, because our oral stories go back to the law, our customs go back to the law, our monuments go back to the law.

So no law means no identity. No law means no culture. No law means no heritage. It is all the same thing. It means lost. Forlorn.

“Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever”. Even David said that the testimonies of God — the laws of God — are a heritage. The laws of our God are our heritage. Strip us of that and we lose everything.

Christianity is literally an identity stripper. It is an identity-stripping doctrine, because it is a doctrine of lawlessness. Without our laws we are not the people. We need the laws; they go hand in hand with our race.

What makes us a peculiar people is God's peculiar laws that he gave us in the first place, which our forefathers kept through their oral stories — and that is part of their heritage.

This is how the heritage was taken. “Neither was it lawful for a man to keep sabbath days or ancient fasts, or to profess himself at all to be a Jew.” That is what the Greeks did: not lawful to keep the sabbath days, not lawful to keep the ancient feasts, not lawful to profess himself at all to be a Jew.

So what did we become at that point? Greeks. Forbidden to keep our laws, over time we were integrated, assimilated into Greek society. We became Greeks, lost in Greco culture — Hellenized Jews who spoke Greek, who knew Greek, who grew up in Greek, because that is all they knew. But they were still our people, the ones Paul was writing to.

Assyria did the same thing before them. The Assyrianization policy: the state provided families with houses, land, agricultural starter kits, and lessons in the imperial Aramaic and Akkadian language. Legal and cultural integration — and that is where America got it from. Conquered peoples were legally declared Assyrian subjects and given equal duties, and intermarriage was actively encouraged. The melting pot. Intermingling, intermixing. The erasure of identity. That is what the Assyrians did.

sense.text:
“Then said God, Call his name Lo–ammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God.” This is regarding Ephraim. What did God say about Ephraim? Ye are not my people. And I will not be your God.

In the Bible, Lo-ammi, not a people, describes a state of spiritual alienation, broken covenant and separation from God, where an individual or a group does not belong to God's chosen community or share in his protective mercy. And spiritual alienation directly causes a loss of identity, because in the biblical context your identity is not something you invent yourself; it is entirely defined by who you belong to.

That is Isaiah 1:3 again. We are lost people. Not a people, not my people — same thing.

And this answers the question they will not answer. If there is no prophecy of Israel losing her identity, where did the ten tribes go? The Israelis say they are Judah, Benjamin and Levi. Where are the other nine? If they are saying they are Israel, then they are not lost; and if they cannot say it, then they are lost. All twelve tribes would be in the land, and only three are where they say they are. They said the Ethiopians are Dan, which is a lie. So where are the other seven or eight? Where did they go?

precepts.why:
It is in the law too. “They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people”.

Those which are not a people. Who is that? That is the northern kingdom. The same sentence spoken over Ephraim in Hosea is written in the law.

“Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.”

To the strangers — they will tell you that means the nations, the Gentiles. But what are they? Scattered. Scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia. And another word for scattered is diaspora. So stop playing with us.

Now see whether it is talking to you. “But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people.” Who is that? Israelites.

“That ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light.” Called you out of darkness into his marvellous light — not being lost any more.

And then the words that settle it: “which in time past were not a people.” Which in time past were not a people. That is the lost identity. The same Lo-ammi spoken over Ephraim is spoken to the strangers scattered abroad. And with that we say shalom.
